name: Social-volume ACCELERATION (not altitude) — long the fresh attention jump while still uncrowded
rationale: NON-OBVIOUS finding from the lead-lag probe (scripts/social_leadlag_probe.py, 30 assets, ~1000 PIT daily bars each): the day-over-day CHANGE in social_volume carries the signal that the absolute LEVEL does not. A fresh acceleration (ln v_t/v_{t-1}) LEADS price UP at k=1-3d — cross-asset mean corr +0.024/+0.030/+0.020, t=+5.3/+9.4/+5.7, 83-100% of assets positive — then decays to insignificance by k=5 (t=+1.67, p=0.105). The same data's LEVEL effect (within-asset z of social_volume -> fwd ret) is only weakly negative and NOT robust on the full sample (best t=-1.98 at k=5, p=0.057), so the altitude guard below is the spec's WEAKEST leg, kept only as a falsifiable hypothesis. A partial-correlation disconfirmer confirms the acceleration edge SURVIVES controlling for the level (raw r +0.030 -> level-residualized r +0.033) — it is genuinely the change, not the altitude, that pays. The generic social cohort that just FAILED the Gate fitted ABSOLUTE volume floors on a series that grew ~160x (2020-26), so its filter was always-true and it tested neither effect. This spec separates them: enter LONG only on a fresh social_volume_accel jump (ride the crowd piling in) WHILE social_attention_z is still BELOW a ceiling (the crowd has NOT already piled in), with own-price momentum confirming. Exit fast (max 3 days, before the k=5 decay) or when the acceleration rolls over. Disconfirmer: the edge must come from the ACCELERATION, not the altitude guard — if dropping the `social_attention_z < alt_ceiling` condition yields an equal-or-better deflated Sharpe (likely, given the level effect is marginal), the altitude leg adds nothing and should be killed, leaving pure attention-momentum. Second disconfirmer: max_hold is capped at 3d because the change->return signal decays to insignificance by k=5; if the fit wants to hold >=5d to make money, the decay finding is violated and the edge is not the one claimed. tier1 + low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: social_volume accelerates (fresh attention jump) while the crowd is not yet crowded and price momentum confirms
